title: Kyouran Reijou Nia Liston

thread.title: Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden • Kyouran Reijou Nia Liston: Byoujaku Reijou ni Tensei shita Kamigoroshi no Bujin no Karei naru Musouroku - Episode 5 discussion

opinions.point: The community was enthusiastic about the tournament direction and felt it helped bring the episode’s setup together.
Many commenters especially enjoyed Lynokis, describing her as highly entertaining and praising her standout moment.
Nia’s extreme battle-seeking personality remained a major source of excitement, with commenters eager to see her encounter a genuinely challenging opponent.
Some commenters liked the episode’s ideas but worried that the tournament may continue emphasizing how overwhelmingly strong Nia is rather than providing meaningful competition.
A few comments criticized or questioned details around the princess’s lack of visible protection and the implications of her political ambitions.
